content: nixpkgs vim docs (vim.section.md, HIGH): vim-full.customize { name = 'vim-cpp'; vimrcConfig.customRC = ...; vimrcConfig.packages.<pkg> = { start; opt; }; } — name sets executable+package name, each customize call yields a distinct wrapper; plugins via native vim packages (start/opt) from pkgs.vimPlugins, NO runtime fetching (vim-plug plug.* is the deprecated alternative). NixOS wiki: customized vim silently ignores ~/.vimrc (config must live in customRC). vim_configurable is a deprecated alias of vim-full. Corroborated by NixOS wiki Vim page + ryantm nixpkgs manual mirror. Residual per-flavor state collisions NOT solved by customize alone: ~/.viminfo, swap/undo/backup dirs, netrw bookmarks, plugin state (gutentags tag files, vimspector configs) are shared across flavors unless explicitly redirected per flavor in customRC.
